candidate_access: No candidate or productive source read. Inputs derived from frozen L0 and public historical sources/signature DTOs.
construction_rules: Use actual Source parser, eval_expr, EvalContext, Engine, TagIntrospector, registries and IntrospectedContent listed in pinned interface.
Each symbol is allocated once with Locator. label:name resolves the actual label in that snapshot. Undefined symbol or operation fails closed.
origin clone_of preserves the real snapshot/value identities before listed overlays. No custom comparator or mock observation record.
An element overlay replaces only elements[Location] using IntrospectedContent::new of the stated content expression and exact fields None/Some sequence; it does not replace index/Location/order.

Read body Result, selection getter, actual public validation for every listed candidate, and actual diagnostics for history_ids. Keep all observations separate and serialize complete errors and spans.

New public APIs execute only on final candidate; no pre-seal positive credit. F06 actual private relation and F07/F08 lifecycle require distinct frozen bindings/tests; these API-bool cases do not claim those missing witnesses.

forbidden: fabricated vanilla nonconvergence warning for Unproven

resources.world: same immutable memory World for all construction, body and replay in one fixture
resources.styles: StyleChain::default_chain unless explicit request style fixture
resources.validation_sink: distinct transactional sink; not product sink
resources.binding_retention: evaluate value_bindings once in declared order and reuse values by name; do not recreate while cloning/replaying

private_pair_link.binding_equivalence: Execute the same three constructor operations once for this case. Bind private pair to these actual left/right Values, not re-created values. Private relation must be Unproven; public validation must independently not certify.

all_channel_binding: Mechanical adapter must pass the actual private discriminant as private_discriminant and exact observed body/selection/validation/diagnosis/sinks. No text normalization. Invoke assert_opaque and require True; any exception/failure rejects control.
structural_conjunct: Final verifier traces every actual Unproven branch: no call to nonconvergence diagnostic construction or warning publication can originate solely from Unproven; source-backed exhaustive branches, not message-only inference.
